rv.q: It was incredible, and knowing it was done only once, just for this audience, is an experience you can't get anywhere else.
Everybody is funny, compelling dreamscape that makes magic of the darkest moment we will all share – the contemplation of our own mortality.

Geiser's ensemble commits to the material, at times with earnestness, at other times with a bit of philosophical distance, but always with an eye toward communicating the show's simple profundities with wit and grace.
